definitions.gloss: legal personality; status as a legal entity
definitions.explanation: The legal standing that lets an organization hold property, sign contracts, and sue in its own name, separately from the people who run it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{法人格|ほうじんかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This organization has no legal personality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{法人格|ほうじんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: It acquired legal personality through registration.

examples.japanese: {法人格|ほうじんかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦{名義|めいぎ}→名義：10623_meigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}い→開く：01979_hiraku⟧たり⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ん→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧だり⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: With legal personality, an organization can open accounts and sign contracts in its own name.

notes:
⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧ (juridical person, corporation) + ⟦{格|かく}→格：13147_kaku⟧ (status, standing). Central to Japanese discussion of NPOs, associations, and companies, since many small groups operate without it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法人格|ほうじんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to acquire legal personality
- {法人格|ほうじんかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: an unincorporated body
- {法人格|ほうじんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have legal personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: legal person, corporation — the entity itself rather than its status
- {権利能力|けんりのうりょく}: capacity to hold rights — the wider legal concept covering individuals too
